planets.name: HD 219666 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 219666 with a 6.03-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: HD 219666 b was found in 2018 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 219666. Its orbit and size follow Murphy et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname MURPHY_ET_AL__2025): disc_year 2018, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 6.03446338952, pl_radj 0.437, pl_bmassj 0.055

quotes.title: HD 219666 b
quotes.card: HD 219666b is a hot Neptune type exoplanet that orbits around the G-type main sequence star named HD 219666.
quotes.introduction: It orbits the star at a distance of 0.06 AU with an orbital period of 6.03 days.
